_comment: Transform LIST composition order (css-transforms-1 §11: 'transform: A B' is the matrix product A·B, so B — the SECOND-listed function — maps the point first; equivalently each function transforms the coordinate system left to right). All six components are one 40x40 box, background #2ecc71 = (46,204,113). ARITHMETIC — bbox of a w x h box rotated by t is (w|cos t|+h|sin t|) x (w|sin t|+h|cos t|). Rigid/uniform pairs (cases 1-4, the four-case probe from docs/STATUS.md 'Transform order'): bbox SIZE is order-invariant, only the centroid moves, and v1 _expect has no position field — so their box asserts the shared size and the centroid arithmetic is recorded here for the v2 bbox field. (1) translate(60,0) rotate(45): rotate first about center (centroid unmoved), then +60x -> centroid base+(60,0); bbox 40*sqrt(2)=56.57 -> [57,57]. (2) rotate(45) translate(60,0): translate first (+60x), then rotate about the box's ORIGINAL center -> centroid base+(60*cos45, 60*sin45)=+(42.4,42.4); bbox [57,57]. (3) scale(2) translate(30,0): translate first, then scale doubles the offset -> centroid +60; bbox 80x80. (4) translate(30,0) scale(2): scale first, then translate -> centroid +30; bbox 80x80. Cases 5-6 DISCRIMINATE BY SIZE because the scale is non-uniform: (5) scaleX(2) rotate(45): rotate maps points first -> diamond bbox 56.57 x 56.57, then scaleX(2) doubles width only -> 113.14 x 56.57 -> [113,57]. (6) rotate(45) scaleX(2): scaleX first -> 80x40, then rotate 45 -> bbox (80+40)*cos45 = 84.85 square -> [85,85]. KNOWN RED (Android): Compose accumulates each function kind into a separate scalar and graphicsLayer applies fixed T·R·S (STATUS 'Transform order' + audit backlog High), which equals case 6's maths — so TLO_ScaleXRotate renders [85,85] instead of [113,57], and TLO_RotateScaleX passes degenerately. iOS was fixed 2026-08-28 (commit b4a26200) and must stay green. GEOMETRY NOTE: the uniform margin keeps transform-escaped paint inside the overflow:hidden 390x(layout+32) capture canvas (CaptureGallery.tsx canvasStyle) — without it a CORRECT renderer clips at the canvas edge and the box expectation reads false-red on every platform. Do not 'simplify' the margin away.

_expect.note: css-transforms-1 §11: rotate maps points first; bbox 40*sqrt(2)=56.57 both orders; centroid base+(60,0) — order visible only to a future v2 bbox field
css-transforms-1 §11: translate maps points first, rotate carries the offset to +(42.4,42.4); same [57,57] bbox as its swap — position-only divergence
css-transforms-1 §11: translate first then scale doubles the offset (centroid +60, web-measured 156 vs Android 126 in STATUS); bbox 80x80 both orders
css-transforms-1 §11: scale first then translate leaves the offset at +30; bbox 80x80 both orders — position-only divergence

css-transforms-1 §11: rotate first (56.57 diamond) then scaleX(2) -> 113.14x56.57. RED on Android today: fixed-order accumulation renders the swap's [85,85] MEASUREMENT NOTE: box is the bbox of fill-band pixels, and a rotated diamond's tips are heavily antialiased, so the strict-colour bbox under-reads the geometric extent by up to ~5px (worst under scaleX(2): web itself measures 108x54 against the geometric 113x57). boxTolerance 6 absorbs that while keeping the bug renders (deltas 25-31px) unmistakable.

waive.Android: OPEN LEDGERED BUG (cross-platform-expectations.json Transform_Combined iOS-Android; STATUS 2026-08-28): Compose does not compose the transform list — per-kind scalar accumulation feeds graphicsLayer's fixed scale-rotate-translate order, so this renders the SWAPPED ordering's ~85x85 (clipped to 82x82). This waiver is the red test that the matrix-composition fix turns stale.
